english.title: Use a firearm / prohibited implement / prohibited thing to take / kill fish
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a

(A)_[ firearm within the meaning of the Firearms Act 1968]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY ONE OR MORE AS APPROPRIATE OF - OTTER, LATH, JACK, WIRE, SNARE, CROSSLINE, SETLINE , SPEAR, GAFF, STROKE-HAUL, SNATCH, OTHER LIKE INSTRUMENT OR LIGHT..)]_

for the purpose of taking or killing salmon, trout, eels, lampreys, smelt, shad, freshwater fish and any specified fish in any waters
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1)(a) of and Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
